"""Fixture: refusal reason legacy-format subject (legacy-kept)."""

from agent_workflows import artifact_meta


def test_legacy_grammar_plan_parses() -> None:
    text = (
        "# IPD: Legacy Subject Plan\n\n"
        "- Id: lg1001\n"
        "- Status: approved\n"
        "- Set: demo\n"
        "- Order: 1\n"
    )
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="ipd")
    assert st.id6 == "lg1001"
    assert st.status == "approved"
